name: markspace
description: Markspace - Zero-Trust, Privacy-First, Edge-Native Markdown Workspace

scripts.deploy:with-no-wasm: npm run build:with-no-wasm && npm run d1:migrate:prod && wrangler deploy
scripts.build:with-wasm: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ui
scripts.deploy:with-wasm: npm run build:with-wasm && npm run d1:migrate:prod && wrangler deploy
scripts.d1:create: wrangler d1 create markspace-db --binding DB && wrangler d1 migrations apply markspace-db --remote
scripts.d1:migrate:local: echo "y" | wrangler d1 migrations apply markspace-db --local
scripts.d1:migrate:prod: echo "y" | wrangler d1 migrations apply markspace-db --remote
